== Description ==
'''SHA-120''' is the one of the many Shadow entities found within the [[Shadow Challenge]] and the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] modifier. He is the infected counterpart of [[D-120]].

== Behaviors ==
'''SHA-120''' spawns from behind the main door, like his [[D-120|uninfected counterpart]]. However, he plays a slightly different drumming sound, and emits purple clouds close to the door. Shortly after, he breaks down the door and falls back towards the void wall. After reaching a certain distance, he rebounds back to the front and breaks the next door he comes in contact with, before slowly falling into the ground and despawning. '''SHA-120''' will leave puddles on the floor that if stepped on will give the player the shadow plague effect, causing them to lose some of their health overtime.

== Strategy & Tips ==

* The best way to hide from '''SHA-120''' without getting [[Claustrophobia]] is to sprint-hide when you hear the 2nd loud low-tone drum. Once he leaves the current room you're in, get out to avoid [[Claustrophobia]]. Wait for your screen to start shaking from '''SHA-120''', then sprint-hide in the locker again, and wait for '''SHA-120''' to despawn.
* It's important to be careful since '''SHA-120''' is one of the few with a lethal lockersnipe, so make sure to not hide too late.
*If you're in the current room where '''SHA-120''' is despawning at, wait ~2 seconds after '''SHA-120''' slams the door then get out.
* Try not to rush while it is active, as other entities can spawn, creating potentially unfair combos. It can even stack on top of itself.

== Trivia ==
* '''SHA-120''' is one of two known shadow entities with a lethal lockersnipe.
* '''SHA-120''' moves just as fast as [[D-120]] if spawned in [[Red Rooms]].
* '''SHA-120''' has a very low chance of replacing [[D-120]]
